item.title: Supercurrent enables the reading of quantum information without destroying it
item.description: One of the fundamental challenges of quantum computing is obtaining information from a quantum bit, or qubit. In other words, reading the information modifies it. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: The transformation of Europe’s busiest shopping street should be a case study in making cities greener, less congested and more inviting places to live Sadiq Khan has been trying to pedestrianise Oxford Street since he first became the mayor of London in 2016. The busiest stretch of the nation’s famous shopping street will be closed to traffic in a scheme designed to improve the area and make it more attractive to pedestrians. item.title: Patterns of polar vortices discovered in lead-free superlattices on silicon
item.description: A team at HZB has, for the first time, reported polar vortices in (BaTiO₃/SrTiO₃)₁₀ superlattices on silicon. These results expand the range of materials and substrates on which polar topological textures can occur and open up new options for incorporating complex ferroelectric states into silicon-based technologies. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Alabama lawyer gave up career to care for parents, but court upheld cancellation of her condo deed
item.description: The Alabama Supreme Court has affirmed a lower court's ruling that invalidated a property transfer from parents to their daughter, Holly Schumpert. Despite her dedication in caring for her ailing parents, the court determined the coastal condominium was part of a family trust, rendering the deed null. As a result, laws designed to protect elderly property owners allowed the reversal, leading to Holly having no claim to the estate. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
